name: core-description-vlm-v0.3-russian-knowledge-pilot

full_book_page_index.use: Local page-indexed reference corpus; curated Russian paraphrases derived from selected concepts were used for SFT.

training_data.collection_scope_note: Broad first-pass source scan, weighted toward Russian reference and case-study sources; not an exhaustive Internet crawl.

training_parameters.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 8 GB VRAM

observations: The first prompt produced unsupported references to nonexistent description numbers and fabricated several visual properties.

After revising the inference prompt, the second output stopped inventing source references but still described the core as homogeneous and slightly fibrous, which conflicts with the approved three-interval target.
This is an in-sample smoke check and not an independent accuracy estimate.

limitations: Only four approved image-description pairs were available for v3, all from one well; image-grounded performance is not reliable.
Text-only examples teach Russian terminology and response discipline, not image-to-pixel associations.
The 65 reference-based text answers are curated paraphrases and have not been reviewed by a geologist.
No independent validation/test split was available; train loss is not a quality metric.
The full book was indexed locally but not used as verbatim SFT targets. Some image-heavy pages were not text-extractable and the extraction index is not a visual/OCR dataset.
Sixteen USGS-derived Russian translation candidates remain pending Russian-language review and were excluded from training.
This adapter does not perform YOLO segmentation or validated depositional-environment/paleochannel classification.
